{"consolidated_memory":"## Data Loss in mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt — Two Separate Incidents

Same corner of the codebase (mobile sync side), but distinct root causes and remedies across two incidents:

### Incident 1: Schema Drift (2026-03-12)
- **File/Component:** mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt (mobile sync side)
- **Problem:** Data loss in offline cache
- **Trigger:** Manifested after client had already retried once
- **Signal:** Local row missing after next launch
- **Root Cause:** Schema drift between the migration and the model
- **Fix:** Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum (PR #1782, branch fix/data-loss-1)
- **Reproduction:** Force stop the app with unsynced edits
- **Outcome:** Backlog cleared 66 minutes after deploy

### Incident 2: Missing Composite Index (2026-08-25)
- **File/Component:** mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt (mobile sync side)
- **Problem:** Data loss in offline cache
- **Trigger:** Manifested after rolling restart of the fleet
- **Signal:** Local row missing after next launch
- **Root Cause:** Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- **Fix:** Added the composite index and backfilled in batches (PR #7777, branch fix/data-loss-2)
- **Reproduction:** Force stop the app with unsynced edits
- **Outcome:** Backfill job finished in 64 minutes instead of 2 hours

Both incidents share the same signal manifestation and repro steps but had entirely different root causes requiring separate fixes deployed 5+ months apart."}
